'''Revery''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] known for being inhabited by rich beings, as well as its [[Beach/Legends|beaches]], mountains, and privacy.<ref name="TCSWE" /> It appeared [[Color/Legends|blue]] from [[Realspace/Legends|space]], and on the planet, there were aquamarine seas, green and gold land, and pink clouds could be seen in the sky.
[[Astri Oddo]] and [[Clive Flax]] visited this planet looking for [[Eve Yarrow]]'s estate.
